source_event.summary: An authorization backfill fixed existing entities but did not propagate the policy to entities created later by a persistent trigger.

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A one-time authorization repair can pass existing-data checks while a persistent creator, trigger, seed, or provisioning path continues to produce the old policy for future entities.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Change only currently persisted rows and omit the durable creation/provisioning path that controls equivalent future entities.
generalized_learning.reusable_control: For authorization migrations, test an existing entity, a newly created equivalent entity after the migration, a denied sibling role/function, and an exact migration rerun.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: When a policy must remain true for future entities, update the durable creation/provisioning mechanism together with any existing-row repair.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Require cross-lifecycle controls that compare existing-row repair with post-migration creation and least-privilege sibling denial.

transfer_cases.scenario: Synthetic permission seed: verify a new entity receives the corrected policy after migration.
Synthetic backfill: drift an existing row, rerun the migration, and verify convergence without duplicates.

skill_changes.evidence: Delivery workflow requires material risk surfaces and durable producer/consumer paths to be closed before freeze.
Risk saturation and inherited-control gates require sibling and lifecycle attack dimensions before independent handoff.
